## About
Ferndale Collision & Auto Repair is a family-owned shop on Vester Ave in Ferndale. We repair cars after accidents, restore older vehicles that time has worn down, and handle the mechanical work that keeps you on the road.
Our staff includes I-CAR certified technicians, and we stand behind our work. Customers tell us they value the help with insurance claims and the regular updates while their car is in the shop.
We're rated 4.7 on Google from 120 reviews. Stop by, give us a call, or ask for Jon.

## Services
- Collision repair: We repair vehicles damaged in collisions and auto accidents and work to restore them to pre-accident condition.
- Frame straightening: Our shop has the technicians and equipment for safe, precise frame straightening.
- Custom painting: We paint replacement panels to match your car and bring back the shine after an accident.
- Classic cars and street rods: We restore rusted, damaged and non-working vehicles using reproduction and original parts.
- Mechanical repair: Engine work and installation, including head work, timing changes, tune-ups and drivability work.
- Interior and exterior detailing: Hand washing, hand waxing, wheel dressing, engine degreasing and a complete interior cleaning.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: You can request an estimate through our website, and you'll hear back from us quickly.

Q: Can I check on my car while it's in the shop?
A: Yes. You can check your vehicle's status online, by email, by text message or on Facebook.
